C0638.title: State-Owned Enterprise Procurement Splitting to Circumvent Bidding
keywords: breaking up the whole into parts
C0638.summary: An audit by a provincial audit office found that Entity B split its annual budget of 2.8 million yuan for office consumables procurement into multiple self-procurement batches, keeping each transaction below the public bidding threshold.
